<thought>Using the ESI mass spectrum, the most intense ion is at m/z 268.1939, which corresponds to the [M+H]⁺ ion. Subtracting the mass of a proton (1.007276 Da) gives a neutral monoisotopic mass of ≈267.1867 Da. The formula that best matches this exact mass is C₁₆H₂₇O₃ (calculated monoisotopic mass = 267.1960 Da, within typical high‑resolution error). No other heteroatoms are required to fit the observed isotopic pattern.</thought>
<final_answer>C16H27O3</final_answer>
